newsitem.title: UK: Carlton down after Rank trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Carlton down after Rank trading statement.

text.p: Shares in Carlton Communications Plc dropped in early trade on Friday, dragged lower by a trading statement from Rank Group Plc which sent the latter's shares sharply lower.
Carlton shares were down 13p at 502-1/2 in volume of 481,000 shares, even as Rank tumbled 21-1/2p to 404.
Dealers highlighted Rank's statement that it had suffered a downturn in profits in its video duplication operations, an area where Carlton also has a substantial presence.

Rank said the first quarter was a "quiet period" for video releases and that this had continued, such that U.S. video duplication volume for the five months was 25 percent below that for the corresponding period the year before.
"That is what has hit Carlton," said one market-maker in the shares.
By 0745 GMT Carlton shares were down 16p at 499-1/2, not far from its year low of 487p set on April 14.
